description: PostgreSQL monitoring dashboard adapted from Grafana.com dashboard 25393 revision 1 by eugeneliukindev. Source: https://grafana.com/api/dashboards/25393/revisions/1/download

panels.description: Whether the selected PostgreSQL exporter can connect to PostgreSQL.
panels.title: PostgreSQL Up

panels.description: Active connections as % of max_connections. Yellow >70%, Red >90%

targets.expr: SUM by (instance) (pg_stat_activity_count{job="postgres", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname"}) / ignoring(server, job) pg_settings_max_connections{job="postgres", instance="$instance"}

panels.title: Connection Pool Utilization

panels.description: Idle in transaction connections hold locks and block autovacuum — dangerous!

targets.expr: pg_stat_activity_count{job="postgres", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname", state="idle in transaction"}
pg_stat_activity_count{job="postgres", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname", state="idle in transaction (aborted)"}

panels.title: Idle in Transaction (Dangerous!)

panels.description: Used vs available connections vs max limit

targets.expr: pg_settings_max_connections{job="postgres", instance="$instance"} - ignoring(server, job) SUM by (instance) (pg_stat_activity_count{job="postgres", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname"})

panels.title: Connection Pool Status

panels.description: Max duration of active transactions. Growing = hung query. Yellow >30s, Red >60s

targets.expr: max by (datname, state) (pg_stat_activity_max_tx_duration{job="postgres", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname", state!="idle"} > 0)

panels.title: Max Transaction Duration

panels.description: Committed and rolled back transactions per second
panels.title: Transaction Throughput

panels.description: Cache hit ratio — should be >99%. Low = excessive disk I/O.

targets.expr: pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname"} / (pg_stat_database_blks_hit{job="postgres", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname"} + pg_stat_database_blks_read{job="postgres", instance="$instance", datname=~"$datname"} + 1)

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: Row operations per second: inserts, updates, deletes, fetches
panels.title: DML Operations Rate

panels.description: Temp files written to disk — indicates work_mem is too low
panels.title: Temp Files (Bytes/s)

panels.description: Lock counts by mode. Spikes indicate contention.
panels.title: Lock Tables

panels.description: Current PostgreSQL backend connections by database.
panels.title: Database Backends

panels.description: Rate of time spent executing SQL by database.
panels.title: Database Active Time

panels.description: Buffer hits and disk block reads per second by database.
panels.title: Database Block Activity

panels.description: Background writer buffer allocation and clean rate
panels.title: Buffers (bgwriter)

panels.description: Replication lag in seconds. Should be close to 0.
panels.title: Replication Lag

title: PostgreSQL Monitoring
